test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which option figure would come next in the following figure series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c78d00a7e4779f26ce2fdc1f2dc41d0e485e72c2419b3996d36ef091718029e.png]
solution:
Logic followed here is:

1) Circle is moved anticlockwise and shift one step backward in next figure. 

2) Triangle is moved clockwise and shift one step forward in next figure. Also rotate down and ups.

3) Arrow is moved anticlockwise and shift one step backward in next figure. Also change their face in all direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b175c8b7b4a215fbd730572848c36020b8e0e6b48f69c6264364374ee1cd9c4a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
